actions.description: Read .NET runtime v10.0.0 EnvironmentVariablesConfigurationProvider source. It normalizes double underscores to colons but accepts existing colon-delimited names, compares configuration keys ignoring case and overwrites duplicate normalized keys during enumeration. This is the authoritative engine behavior used to inspect the owned-instance environment scrub; no standalone experiment or test run performed. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dotnet/runtime/v10.0.0/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.EnvironmentVariables/src/EnvironmentVariablesConfigurationProvider.cs
